artist: Pulling Back The Curtain On YEARN IV
title: Breaking And Entering: Pulling Back The Curtain On YEARN IV
summary: One half of the duo behind Triple R’s Album of the Week in May of 2025, Kuya Neil, dropped into the studio on the release week of his and Teether’s collaborative album, YEARN IV. Kuya Neil talks about the behind the scenes of writing the album and its contrast in recording from the duo’s two previously released mixtapes. While the two performing producers have always drawn influence from genres like electronica and metal, Kuya Neil talks about how this time they went down to the Mornington Peninsula to intentionally slow down and refine their sound.
